versions.name: Camp Edgewood

features.note: Automatic low and high houses on the shotgun range.
A tomahawk and knife throwing range.
A lake with canoes and rowboats.
A dining hall seating two hundred fifty, with a commercial kitchen.
A council ring bookable for exclusive use.
Three of the fourteen campsites have electricity.

versions.summary: Calcasieu Area Council's 283-acre camp in southern Beauregard Parish between DeQuincy and Ragley, near Lake Charles. Offers 14 campsites, archery, rifle, and shotgun ranges, and a dining hall, hosting resident summer camp, year-round unit camping, and a Cub Scout day camp.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
